title: Anchor Bulletin — Spring
summary: The childcare co-op, Holding Steady's rest days, and the Anchor Family Feast.

items: Now to wrap — childcare co-op sign-ups at the Welcome Desk
Study habit — Holding Steady's rest days (day 6 of every week) are the keeper weeks

blocks.text: Holding Steady, the Anchor Spring guide, has a deliberate rhythm: five days of verses, one day of rest, one day of reflection — every week. The study habit for a single parent is the daily verse that fits one hand: cast the anxiety, take the breath, hold the steady. You are not the sea. And you are not holding it alone — the co-op, the Catch-up and the Feast are the village this season.
We have this hope as an anchor for the soul, firm and secure.
You are not holding it alone.
